# Contributing

Report bugs, feature requests, and documentation gaps through the [issue forms](https://github.com/cyanheads/brapi-mcp-server/issues/new/choose). Search existing issues first and include the server and framework versions, runtime, transport, exact inputs, and actual versus expected behavior. Redact credentials, auth headers, internal URLs, and personal data.

File BrAPI tool, schema, and upstream-data problems in this repository. Report transport, auth, config, or builder defects against [mcp-ts-core](https://github.com/cyanheads/mcp-ts-core/issues) once isolated to the framework. If the cause is unclear, file here.

Agents should read [report-issue-local](../framework-skills/report-issue-local/SKILL.md) or [report-issue-framework](../framework-skills/report-issue-framework/SKILL.md) before filing on a user's behalf.

Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/cyanheads/brapi-mcp-server/security/advisories/new), following [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
